Plan v2, 2 Jan office day, discussion version, prose pending approval; evening discussion: open questions + Shivani home early -> Om Uncle catching scene.

Updated 25 Nov 2026, Asia/Calcutta (IST). Yeh wahi Google Doc hai; purani 8-scene prose draft replace ho chuki hai. Repo mein commit nahi hua. Morning home scene (office aane tak) locked/approved hai — uski prose yahan repeat nahi ki. Neeche office plot beats hain, prose nahi. Sexual beats plot-level aur non-graphic hain. Koi promotion / career-for-sex framing nahi.
1. Canon locks
• Three twin pairs, locked: Karan–Aman (common society twins), Ayaan–Armaan (Shivani-focus society pair), Harsh–Laksh (office adult students, age 23).
• Slow burn: Shivani ka sex kisi ke saath nahi, shauhar Rohan ke alawa, lagbhag EP69 tak. Usse pehle layer-by-layer teasing, shyness layers dheere utarti hain.
• 1 Jan Deepu = accident (first show nahi). 2 Jan = first show.
• 2 Jan Shivani lock: no kiss, no nudity. Jo actual touch ho, us par clear consent.
• 09:00 ki ek line: twins aur students apni classes mein busy hain. Is office day par sirf staffroom interactions aur Chotu (Sunny), kyunki yehi free hain. Zero twins on the 2 Jan office floor.
• Sunny innocent hai. Shivani control karti hai aur lead karti hai. Sunny ki line “comfortable hain?” drop.
• Uncles / management seniors main characters hain, bonds evolve karte hain. Koi villain, coercion, ya promotion-for-sex framing nahi.
• Office seniors: Trustee Malhotra (60, office side par sabse bade). Principal Dheeraj (52) background mein. Mahendra Suri (61) society chairman hain, is office day par nahi.

• Photo status: Aarav, Dheeraj aur Malhotra ne EP02 C03 mein photo dekhi. Pooja, Kriti aur Shivani ko nahi pata. C03 wording: deep maroon saree styled like lingerie, wet-looking blouse that barely covered her, midriff and most of her torso exposed — barely-covered, nude nahi. Repo mein koi “80%” figure nahi hai.
• A03 (Shivani POV) vs C03 (mardon ka projector POV) mein photo description inconsistent hai. Working assumption (pending final lock): C03 ko “jo screen par dikha” maana jaaye.
2. Full 2 Jan office beat timeline (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, IST)

Saari timings Asia/Calcutta (IST). Morning home beat locked hai, isliye timeline office arrival se shuru hoti hai. 6:00 PM ke baad ghar; Deepu 6:12 PM aur Om Uncle catching evening discussion ke liye open hain (Section 7).
09:00 — Twins / students, ek line
Harsh, Laksh, Nandini, Ritika aur Arjun apni classes mein busy hain. Staffroom aur Sunny free hain. Iske baad office floor par koi twin/student beat nahi.
09:07 — Faculty room, arrival
Shivani ink-blue office kurta, churidar aur ivory dupatta mein aati hai (outfit detail Section 4). Kriti ek simple compliment deti hai.

Aarav aata hai. Uska register pehle se bold / straightforward hai, mild respectful-peer nahi. Pehla hovering beat, body ko directly notice karta hai — figure, neckline, yeh kaise baithti hai — coded “visual impact” wali narmi nahi.
Pooja aur Kriti notice karti hain ki uski nazar zyada der Shivani par rukti hai.
10:40 — Break space / khaali room: Aarav ka game

Chaar adults: Shivani, Pooja (23), Kriti (24), Aarav (35). Yeh B03 faculty-room banter ka seedha next step hai (“Teen confident women… final decision hum teenon milkar lenge”). Ab judge Aarav khud hai.

Game: playful competition — “kiske zyada heavy hain?” Judge Aarav, dekh ke. Categories: announced main category heaviness hai; baaki jokey side-comments (kaun zyada confident baithe, kaun zyada naturally carry karta hai) sirf baat tak, koi alag physical test nahi. Ticket check uska official judging move hai: Pooja aur Kriti ke liye woh flirty, jokey andaaz mein clothing ko halka kheenchkar / neckline ke andar jhaank kar “ticket check” karta hai, jaise entry check ho. Dono allow karti hain, hansi ke saath. Verdicts jokey rehte hain (“dono ka alag-alag jeet”).

Aarav ka register poore scene mein straightforward body talk hai — cleavage/figure/heaviness seedhe words mein, double meaning ke saath, sharif peer-compliment nahi. Natural touches: Pooja aur Kriti ke saath chair ke kareeb aana, judging ke dauran shoulder/arm ya waist ke bahar kapde par halka haath, ticket-check tug — yeh unki allowed, consensual teasing hai. Shivani ke saath bhi natural closeness hai (paas khada hona, kursi, baat ke dauran arm/shoulder ka incidental brush), lekin uski clothing tug / ticket check usne khud rok di.

Shivani physical ticket-check mein hissa nahi leti. Woh thodi door, chai ke saath, hansti hai. Aarav uske paas aata hai: “Judge ko evidence chahiye,” aur uski dori ya dupatta / neckline ki taraf haath badhata hai. Shivani uski kalai pakad leti hai: “Judge sirf aankhon se.” Woh haath hata leta hai, aur sirf aankhon se dekhta hai — waist, hip, neckline — koi clothing peek nahi.
Phir Aarav, photo yaad karke (C03: exposed waist / navel / barely-covered breasts, wet-sheer), kehta hai: “Kuch bhi kaho, Shivani ji se sexy abhi tak koi nahi dekha.”
Shivani: “Abhi tak? Kahan dekha aapne?”
Aarav coded tal deta hai: “Staffroom mein bahut kuch dikhta hai.” Pooja–Kriti ko yeh sirf flirt lagta hai. Shivani ko halki uljhan hoti hai; reader ko photo ka pata hai.

Pooja aur Kriti mein jealousy: “Hum dono ko chhodkar Shivani ji?” Woh Aarav ko challenge karti hain aur thoda escalate karti hain (clothed, jokey leaning / hugs, apni marzi se). Shivani blush karke excuse banati hai (“Sunny ka cue check”) aur nikal jaati hai.
Shivani ne yahan kya allow kiya: hasna, rukna, nazar, incidental closeness. Nahi: ticket-check, neckline tug, competition mein physical hissa, kiss, nudity.

Revised, Dhika EP04-level. Poori physical clarity Section 4 mein hai. Short: Shivani abhi Aarav ke words se garam hai. Mic-pack fitting ke liye woh khud dupatta chair par rakhati hai, ek baar jhukti hai, Sunny kneel/low stool se front neckline ke andar dekhta hai (~3–5 seconds, upper cleavage ~1/4 se 1/3, clothed). Woh stunned aur innocent rehta hai, touch nahi karta. Shivani seedhe hote hi unsure rehti hai ki usne kya dekha. Back-dori wala accident drop ho chuka hai.

Dupatta wapas. Mirror mein ek baar. Heat aur curiosity (“Usne dekha? Kya dekha?”). Koi self-touch nahi. Slow burn.

Dono Shivani ko Aarav par tease karti hain (“Aarav ka naya favourite?”). Ek doosre ko bhi B03 history yaad dilati hain: “Kal tak toh tumhe privately bula raha tha.” / “Aur tumhe challenge kar raha tha.” Halki jealousy, serious nahi. Aarav common point hai; dono ka alag thread bhi hai.

Malhotra walkthrough ke liye aate hain. Pooja–Kriti unhe hall dikhane jaati hain. Pehli baar un par uski quiet, deliberate attention hai (seed). Koi career/approval ka zikr nahi. Dono apni marzi se jaati hain.

Pooja aur Kriti lagbhag ek ghante baad lautti hain. Shivani notice karti hai, plot-level cues:

• Kriti ke collar ke paas halka kiss mark, makeup ke neeche
• dono ke chehre par post-sex glow, relaxed chamak

Us pal Shivani ko samajh nahi aata. Woh maanti hai ki pantry ka cream roll hoga (shyness layer). Kriti angoothe se saaf karti hai, Pooja ki taraf dekhti hai; dono hasti hain.
3:10 PM — Green room, mini glimpse (plot-level only)

Shivani costume change ke raaste mein hai. Trustee green room ka door thoda khula hai. Mini glimpse, 2–3 second, fragmentary: Pooja, Kriti aur Malhotra (60, oldest office senior). Pooja close-up / oral position mein; Kriti usi waqt uske saath ride position mein; Malhotra calm. Dono ki awaaz/cues se unki apni marzi dikhti hai. Shivani ko sirf silhouette, awaazein, aur ek-do cues milte hain; anatomy ya act ki detail nahi. Woh peeche hat jaati hai. Use koi nahi dekhta.

Click: subah ka residue samajh aata hai. Shock, sharam, aur saath hi curiosity. Yeh Pooja ke action-boldness (EP02 B03 / EP03 S02) aur Kriti ki jealousy-driven choice se match karta hai. Is beat ko sirf plot-level rakha jaaye; graphic prose yahan nahi likhi jaayegi.
3:25 PM — Sunny ka first show, backstage

Revised, Dhika EP04-level. Poori physical clarity Section 4 mein hai. Short: Shivani lead karti hai, cream jacket khud utarti hai, floor-mark par jaan-bujhkar ~1 minute lean karti hai, ~1/3 clothed cleavage dikhati hai. Ek side placket slip usse notice nahi hota (use AC/fan lagta hai). Sunny shocked, wide-eyed, innocent, touch nahi karta. Aankhen milte hi woh fumble karke nikalne ki koshish karta hai. Upper-back caress drop ho chuka hai. Motivation: Aarav ke words + 11:05 ki uncertainty + glimpse (dusre apni marzi se kaise choose karte hain).
4:10 PM — Optional Aarav cameo
Aarav hall mein aata hai, rehearsal costume dekhta hai. “Shivani ji…” Shivani ek second ke liye uski nazar rukne deti hai, phir “Aarav, rehearsal.” Koi naya touch nahi.
6:00 PM — Day end, ghar; us raat Rohan ke saath bum-slap seed
Shivani campus gate se nikalti hai. Rohan ka text. Koi nayi photo nahi bhejti. Deepu ka 6:12 PM silhouette alag society beat ho sakta hai — abhi open (Section 7, recommend: chhota rakhna).

Ghar par, shauhar Rohan ke saath private time mein (consenting married couple; husband ke saath sex slow-burn lock ke andar allowed hai): ek playful, consensual slap uski bum par. Shivani ko apni unexpected, strong erotic reaction ka pata chalta hai — use andaza nahi tha ke yeh usse itna affect karega, aur yeh reaction use pasand bhi aata hai. Yeh sirf seed hai, lamba scene nahi, plot-level. Baad ke arcs ke liye file ho jaata hai; 2 Jan ko yeh kisi aur ke saath extend nahi hota.
3. Dhika EP04 benchmark extract

Accident (EP03 end + EP04 first half, Friday, ghar)

Outfit: college se aake “a lovely kurti” (EP03 [54]). Color prose mein nahi; official stills red gold-embroidered kurti, 3/4 sleeves, square neckline with chhota centre placket. Dupatta/shawl pehle thi. EP03 [69–76]: arranging ke dauran usne dupatta sofa par phenk di; Pappu ne nahi chhodi. “It is only her innocent Chotu” sochkar bina dupatta darwaza khola. Author note [77]: “Look at the picture above and remember how deep cut her Kurti is.” EP04 [10]: “Chotu noticed something little different in her dress, but did not mind it much.”

Kya hua: Chotu floor par Pappu ke saath wrestling kar raha tha. Dhika juice leke jhuki — “as Chotu was on the floor, she bent down to give it to him” [16]. Duration: ek hi jhukao, lagbhag 3–5 seconds, 1 minute nahi. Angle: woh khadi, woh neeche floor par; nazar upar se uski deep neckline ke andar. Sirf front. Prose mein back, waist, navel ka zikr nahi. Official juice-still mein bhi dress kamar par bandh hai.

Chotu ne actually kya dekha: prose jaan-bujhkar uncertain hai. Dhika: “I bent down without wearing dupatta. what if he saw inside my dress.” [19] Baad mein: “couldn't be sure if he saw her cleavage or her bra or what if something more was visible.” [32] Official juice-still (physical upper bound): lean par neckline khul jaati hai; dono breasts ke inner slope / upper cleavage, rough upar ka ek-tihai, nipple covered, koi nudity nahi.

Just ....” juice sip, bina paise liye nikal gaya [29].

Dhika ki awareness: jhukte waqt pata nahi chala; seedhe hote hi realized [17]. Poochhti hai “why do you look stunned??” Woh tal deta hai. Baad mein galat padhti hai: Maami ke “poor kid… help his mother” par sochti hai ke dream-state ghar ki fikr thi [50]. Raat: “Did he see parts of my breast”, tingle down the spine, unconscious smile; soch hata kar so jaati hai [75–85].

4. Revised Sunny beats: 11:05 accident aur 3:25 first show
Outfit logic (ek decision, do garments)

Do garments, ek hi access logic — Dhika jaisa (Day 1 “lovely kurti”, Day 2 alag “home-only” low-cut). Justification: locked morning scene mein garment bag + cream cover jacket pehle se hai; 3:25 staff-only rehearsal naturally alag outfit maangti hai. Dono mein hataayi jaane wali cover layer + itni gehli front neckline ke jhukne par cleavage khule.

11:05 office kurta: deep ink-blue cotton-silk kurta (1 Jan ke plum se alag), 3/4 sleeves, churidar, sheer ivory dupatta. Neckline shallow square / soft U, beech mein chhota placket. Seedhe khadi + dupatta = faculty-normal, cleavage covered. Dupatta hata kar seedhe khadi: halki cleavage-line dikh sakti hai. Jhukne par (45–60°), neeche se: neckline gapes — upper cleavage, inner slopes, upar ka chaar-hissa se ek-tihai tak; nipple covered. Kurta kamar par bandh; kamar / navel / peeth is beat mein nahi khulte. Back-dori garment fact ho sakti hai, in do beats ka event nahi.

3:25 staff-only rehearsal costume: coordinated darker ink/teal, “yeh corridor mein nahi pehenti”. Sleeveless ya cap sleeve, front neckline subah se saaf taur par deeper scoop/V. Seedhe khadi, jacket utre: cleavage ki line dikhti hai. Jhukne par: confirmed ~1/3 of the breast curve, clothed, nipple covered — Dhika ke “1/3rd” ke barabar, usse zyada nahi. Cover = cream jacket (locked morning bag). Neeche rehearsal trouser/palazzo (saree nahi, taaki Deepu wale pallu se overlap na ho). Peeth simple / mildly open as garment fact (Section 7); staged back-reveal nahi.
11:05 accident — AV booth, exactly what happens

Shivani khud ivory dupatta utaar kar booth ki chair par rakh deti hai — “sirf fitting ke liye, 30 second.” Phir cue sheet / pack dekhne ko ek baar jhukti hai.

Sunny exactly kya dekhta hai: angle neeche se upar, saamne, ink-blue neckline ke andar. Sirf front. Duration: ek lean, ~3–5 seconds. Dikhta hai: upper cleavage, dono taraf ke inner slope, centre ka skin-gap, roughly top quarter to a third. Nipple nahi. Bra/inner ka edge maybe ek jhalak, confirm nahi. Back nahi. Waist ki skin nahi — uske haath clothed kamar par pack clip karte hain, woh alag baat hai.

Uski reaction (innocent, koi aage nahi badhta): kaam ki focus/hansi gayab, dream-state, chup. “Uh… haan ma’am? Aapne kuch kaha?” “Errr… kuch nahi, ma’am. Bas…” clip chhuta, kaan laal, gulp. Pack jaldbaazi mein lagaata hai, nazar hataane ki koshish. Koi sawaal, koi touch, koi “comfortable hain?” nahi.

Shivani ka misread: jhukte waqt pata nahi. Seedhe hote hi: “Dupatta chair par thi… usne andar dekha kya?” Poochhti hai kyun stunned hai. Woh tal deta hai. Us pal ki reading: “Mic mushkil tha / woh shy hai.” Curious rehti hai, sure nahi — cleavage, inner neckline, ya kuch nahi. Aarav ki “sexy” wali line is uncertainty ko baad mein garam karti hai.
3:25 first show — backstage / stage mark, exactly what happens

Shivani lead karti hai. Cover jacket woh khud chair par rakhati hai. Pehla chhota beat (Dhika kitchen sleeveless notice jaisa): Sunny pehle bare shoulders / arms dekhta hai, chup. Phir woh khud floor-mark / gaffer tape check karne saamne jhukti hai — yeh all-fours floor-wipe ka stage equivalent hai, copy nahi. Sunny uske saamne, thoda neeche baitha hai. Woh pose jaan-bujhkar ~1 minute rokati hai. Haath mark ya cue card par, ya baal hataaye — neckline khud nahi kheechti.

Jaan-bujhkar kya dikhati hai (Dhika ke 1/3 par rukna): front cleavage, lagbhag ek-tihai breast curve, clothed, no nipple, no nudity. Shoulders already visible (jacket off). Staged back, waist/navel, kiss, touch — nahi. Upper-back caress bhi drop: Dhika ke first show mein Chotu ne sirf dekha tha.

Natural extra slip (use pata nahi chalta): 1 minute ke dauran ek taraf ka placket/strap ek ungli aur dheela ho jaata hai; us side thoda zyada dikhta hai, abhi bhi nipple covered, overall level ~1/3 ke aas-paas. Use halki hawa mehsoos hoti hai, sochti hai stage ka fan/AC hai, adjust nahi karti. Sunny ko us side thodi zyada jhalak milti hai jo usne plan nahi ki thi.

Sunny (innocent): shocked, wide-eyed, bol nahi paata, jagah se nahi hilta, touch nahi karta, kareeb nahi aata. 1 minute lost in the sight. Jab woh himmat karke upar dekhti hai aur aankhen milti hain: woh jhat se uthhta hai, “L-light… theek hai, ma’am,” cable almost girti hai, incomplete bye, nikalne ki koshish. Koi consent-check line nahi — lead uski thi, uski nazar ne poochha.
Uske baad (plot-level): use yaqeen nahi ki yeh usne kiya; blush, shyness, private tingle (Dhika [141] ke level par, graphic nahi).
